fieldValues.title: Protocol run execution over MCP was deferred, deliberately and on the record
fieldValues.summary: Only the read surface landed. The run verbs (create_run, advance_stage and the rest) were left out because the issue mentions them only conditionally — 'if run state should be agent-visible' — and nothing in the programme yet needs an agent to observe or advance a run.
evidence: srs-rust#955 mentions run verbs conditionally, not as a requirement
PR #965 states the deferral explicitly under 'Not in this PR', alongside the skipped protocol_find_by_target_type tool
The programme's own protocol walking today is read-only: stages are read for guidance, run state is not recorded over MCP
fieldValues.body: Recorded so the next thread does not read the absence as an oversight and build it speculatively. Agent-visible run state is a real design question — where a run lives, who may advance it, whether an agent advancing its own run means anything — and it should be opened by a unit that has a consumer needing it, not folded silently into a read-surface PR.
